documents.title: Scott County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 129 pages. Amounts are the FY2026 (Exhibit A, adopted by reference in Ordinance 2026-1) column. The document is a scan; it was read with optical character recognition, and every parent total was checked against its parts.
